picks.title: How AI helped bring an ancient tomb dating to before the Roman Empire back to life
picks.excerpt: Pairing artificial intelligence with acoustic technology let archaeoacousticians reconstruct how the Etruscan Tomb of the Blue Demons sounded.
picks.rationale: Fresh AI x archaeoacoustics study with a striking visual; no archaeology-acoustics story in 30-day history, strong teaser card.

picks.title: AI chatbots endorse existing climate-related policies twice as often as new proposals
picks.excerpt: University of Waterloo researchers tested 11 LLMs on 7,500+ queries: chatbots endorsed existing plans about 70% of the time versus 34% for new ones, and under-recommended EVs relative to actual sales (Environmental Research Communications).
picks.rationale: New peer-reviewed measurement of status-quo bias across 11 LLMs on climate policy; concrete numbers, distinct from the 10-06 'knowledge collapse' piece.

picks.title: Does better work always mean better workers?
picks.excerpt: In a three-month RCT with practicing patent attorneys (David Autor et al.), routine AI use lifted work quality across the board; senior lawyers gained stronger judgment while juniors showed no average skill gain, their scores polarizing.
picks.rationale: Field RCT (Autor et al.) separating output quality from skill growth; a different study from the 10-10 EurekAlert persistence experiment.

picks.title: Is AI the End of Math As We Know It?
picks.excerpt: Mathematicians are facing AI's sudden advance with grief, anger and a search for fresh ideas: 'If we don't adapt, there's just no more math in 50 years.'
picks.rationale: Quanta's field-wide reckoning on how mathematicians are adapting; a standalone piece, not a follow-up to the Unique Games or Fields-medalist cards.

picks.title: Nobel physics winner's pride at pioneering AI role
picks.excerpt: Nobel laureate Francis Halzen recalled his early push for AI in neutrino research, including a 1991 paper proposing it for particle-physics data. Neural networks later helped IceCube pull the Milky Way out of its neutrino data.
picks.rationale: Timely Nobel-week angle on neural networks in IceCube neutrino astronomy; no Nobel or neutrino story in history.
